hive_file.description: Path to the Windows Registry hive file (e.g., SYSTEM, SAM, NTUSER.DAT) to parse.

hive_type.description: The hive type/profile to use. Valid values: sam, security, software, system, ntuser.

plugin.description: Specific plugin to run (e.g., 'run', 'recentdocs_tln'). Leave empty for automatic plugin selection.

check_dirty.description: Check to see if the hive is dirty.

guess_type.description: Guess the hive file type automatically.

extra_plugins.description: List of additional plugin names to append to the command line.

output_file.description: Path to redirect output to. If empty, output goes to STDOUT.
